[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] '''Govak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] serving with the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance military]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. During one of his mission he, despite him being certain to be ready for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperials]], was ambushed by a superior number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].
